title: Baselines block
description: Structural contract for `data/standards/baselines.yaml` (full) and the `baselines:` top-level block in `coldpress.yaml` (partial). Enforces per-category confirmation status, opt-out rationale, and override shape.
Map of baseline category name → category decision object.

status.description: User's decision on this baseline category.

covered_by_pack.description: Whether the selected stack pack handles this baseline out of the box.

opted_out_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the user opted out. Null if not opted out.

rationale.description: Required when status is `opted-out`. Explains the decision.

overrides.description: Optional key-value map of implementation parameter overrides (e.g. `cwv_lcp_threshold: "2.0s"`).
